title: Cosmic Birth of Stars
description: A bearded man in a green jacket sits on a stool in the left foreground, reaching toward a glowing ethereal woman made of stars and galaxies who floats in the center. Several babies rest in bassinets on a swirling cosmic platform while young children reach up toward glowing orbs and floating galaxies in a vibrant nebula-filled space.
prompt: A bearded man wearing a green jacket and blue scarf sits on a stool reaching out toward a beautiful ethereal woman composed of stars galaxies and flowing dark hair who floats above him emitting glowing orbs, several infants sleep in white bassinets on a swirling cosmic platform while young children of different ethnicities reach up in wonder, the background is a vibrant space scene filled with colorful nebulae spiral galaxies and floating flowers, surreal fantasy style with magical glowing elements and swirling energy
